title: Amazon Data Services IAD-215 Air Permit 74252-2
summary: Virginia DEQ's issued-permit registry links Loudoun County facility IAD-215 to minor new-source-review permit 74252-2 issued April 6, 2026.
key_findings: The registry names the facility, permit number, issue date, jurisdiction, and permit class.
The permit creates a facility-level air-compliance trail.
Issuance does not establish equipment installation, testing, operating hours, or facility service.
why_it_matters: It converts a broad permit rail into a named Loudoun project record.
ftfn_relevance: Supports later testing, monitoring, modification, and compliance checks.
evidence_limits: The permit is not proof of constructed or tested generators.
It does not establish grid service, data-center completion, or measured emissions.
